next:wr:184.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:184.hint: 彼女は髪を切ってもらった(切らせた)
next:wr:184.explanation: have+O+過去分詞『Oを〜してもらう』(受身的、OとCが受動の関係)。
next:wr:184.relatedInfo: She had him cut her hair.(能動)との違いに注意。

next:wr:186.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:186.hint: 彼は騒音の中でも自分の声が届くように大声で叫んだ
next:wr:186.answer: He shouted loudly to make himself heard over the noise.
next:wr:186.fullSentence: He shouted loudly to make himself heard over the noise.
next:wr:186.explanation: make oneself heard『自分の声を届かせる(聞こえるようにする)』。make+O+過去分詞。
next:wr:186.relatedInfo: make oneself understood『自分の言うことをわからせる』も同じ形。

next:wr:188.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:188.hint: 彼の年齢を考慮すると、彼はとても活発だ
next:wr:188.answer: Considering his age, he is very active.
next:wr:188.fullSentence: Considering his age, he is very active.
next:wr:188.explanation: considering=〜を考慮すると。慣用的独立分詞構文の一つ。

next:wr:190.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:190.hint: そうは言ったものの、私はまだ挑戦すべきだと思う
next:wr:190.answer: Having said that, I still think we should try.
next:wr:190.fullSentence: Having said that, I still think we should try.
next:wr:190.explanation: having said that=そうは言うものの。慣用的独立分詞構文。

next:wr:192.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:192.hint: すべてを考慮すると、それは良い決断だった
next:wr:192.answer: All things considered, it was a good decision.
next:wr:192.fullSentence: All things considered, it was a good decision.
next:wr:192.explanation: all things considered=すべてを考慮すると。
next:wr:192.relatedInfo: 文頭でよく使われる慣用的分詞構文。

next:wr:194.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:194.hint: 一般的に言って、女性は男性より長生きだ
next:wr:194.answer: Generally speaking, women live longer than men.
next:wr:194.fullSentence: Generally speaking, women live longer than men.
next:wr:194.explanation: generally speaking=一般的に言えば。分詞構文の意味を明確にする慣用副詞句。

next:wr:196.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:196.hint: 厳密に言うと、トマトは果物だ
next:wr:196.answer: Strictly speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
next:wr:196.fullSentence: Strictly speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
next:wr:196.relatedInfo: 一般的な認識とは異なる事実を述べるときによく使う。

next:wr:198.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:198.hint: 映画と言えば、新作を見た?
next:wr:198.answer: Speaking of movies, have you seen the new one?
next:wr:198.fullSentence: Speaking of movies, have you seen the new one?
next:wr:198.relatedInfo: 話題を変えるときの慣用表現。

next:wr:200.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:200.hint: あなたがそこに立っていては歌を歌えない
next:wr:200.answer: I can't sing a song with you standing there.
next:wr:200.fullSentence: I can't sing a song with you standing there.
next:wr:200.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+現在分詞『〜が…している状態で』。
next:wr:200.relatedInfo: standは能動的な動作なので現在分詞standingを使う。

next:wr:202.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:202.hint: 宿題を終えたので、私は寝た
next:wr:202.answer: Having finished my homework, I went to bed.
next:wr:202.fullSentence: Having finished my homework, I went to bed.
next:wr:202.explanation: 完了分詞構文(Having+Vpp)。主節の時制より前の出来事を表す。
next:wr:202.relatedInfo: Finishing my homeworkだと主節と同時になってしまう。

next:wr:204.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:204.hint: 会社はその結果を公表することにした
next:wr:204.answer: The company decided to make the results known.
next:wr:204.fullSentence: The company decided to make the results known.
next:wr:204.explanation: make O known『Oを知らせる、公表する』。make+O+過去分詞(既知の状態にする)の語法。
next:wr:204.relatedInfo: make oneself understoodと同じmake+O+過去分詞のパターン。

next:wr:206.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:206.answer: He was sitting with his legs crossed.
next:wr:206.fullSentence: He was sitting with his legs crossed.
next:wr:206.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞。
next:wr:206.relatedInfo: 脚は「組まれる」受動関係なのでcrossedを使う。

next:wr:208.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:208.answer: He was sitting with a pipe in his mouth.
next:wr:208.fullSentence: He was sitting with a pipe in his mouth.
next:wr:208.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。

next:wr:210.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:210.answer: You should decide with this in mind.
next:wr:210.fullSentence: You should decide with this in mind.
next:wr:210.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。決断する際の慣用表現。
next:wr:210.relatedInfo: with A in mindで『Aを念頭に置いて』。

next:wr:212.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:212.answer: He was standing with a book under his arm.
next:wr:212.fullSentence: He was standing with a book under his arm.
next:wr:212.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。
next:wr:212.relatedInfo: under one's armで『脇にかかえて』。

next:wr:214.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:214.answer: He was sitting with snow in his hair.
next:wr:214.fullSentence: He was sitting with snow in his hair.
next:wr:214.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。

next:wr:216.hint: この本はあの本ほど面白くない
next:wr:216.answer: This book is not as interesting as that one.
next:wr:216.fullSentence: This book is not as interesting as that one.
next:wr:216.relatedInfo: notを伴わない原級比較(A=B)との対比。

next:wr:218.hint: できるだけ早く返信してください
next:wr:218.answer: Please reply as soon as possible.
next:wr:218.fullSentence: Please reply as soon as possible.
next:wr:218.explanation: as+原級+as possible ＝ as+原級+as S can『できるだけ〜』。
next:wr:218.relatedInfo: as soon as you canとも言い換え可能。

next:wr:220.hint: この箱はあの箱の2倍重い
next:wr:220.answer: This box is twice as heavy as that one.
next:wr:220.fullSentence: This box is twice as heavy as that one.
next:wr:220.relatedInfo: 三倍以上はX timesを使う。

next:wr:222.hint: 彼女は私の2倍の数の本を持っている
next:wr:222.answer: She has twice the number of books that I have.
next:wr:222.fullSentence: She has twice the number of books that I have.
next:wr:222.explanation: twice the+名詞+of/that B(名詞を使った倍数表現)。
next:wr:222.relatedInfo: twice as many books as I have とも言い換え可能。

next:wr:224.hint: 彼は私に挨拶さえしなかった
next:wr:224.answer: He didn't so much as say hello to me.
next:wr:224.fullSentence: He didn't so much as say hello to me.
next:wr:224.explanation: not so much as doing『〜さえしない』。
next:wr:224.relatedInfo: notを伴わずwithoutと組み合わせても使える(without so much as doing)。

next:wr:226.hint: このバッグは私が持っているどれにも劣らず良い
next:wr:226.answer: This bag is as good as any I have.
next:wr:226.fullSentence: This bag is as good as any I have.
next:wr:226.explanation: as+原級+as any(最上級的な意味を持つ原級表現)。
next:wr:226.relatedInfo: 『どのバッグにも劣らず』という最上級のニュアンス。

next:wr:228.hint: この本はあの本ほど面白くない(比較級の否定)
next:wr:228.answer: This book is not more interesting than that one.
next:wr:228.fullSentence: This book is not more interesting than that one.
next:wr:228.explanation: 比較級の否定(not+比較級+than)でA≦Bを表す。
next:wr:228.relatedInfo: not as interesting as とほぼ同じ意味になる。

next:wr:230.hint: 彼は年をとればとるほど、確信を持つようになる
next:wr:230.answer: The older he grows, the more certain he becomes.
next:wr:230.fullSentence: The older he grows, the more certain he becomes.
next:wr:230.explanation: The+比較級SV, the+比較級SV『〜すればするほど…』。
next:wr:230.relatedInfo: 2つの比較級が対応する構文。

next:wr:232.hint: 良い規則は繰り返し言われたからといって悪くなるわけではない
next:wr:232.answer: A good rule is none the worse for being repeated.
next:wr:232.fullSentence: A good rule is none the worse for being repeated.
next:wr:232.explanation: none the+比較級+for A『Aだからといって少しも〜でない』。
next:wr:232.relatedInfo: all the+比較級+for(肯定的な文脈)との対比。
